articles.summary: PEMBROKE, Bermuda, June 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - AXIS Capital Holdings Limited (“AXIS Capital” or “AXIS” or the “Company”) (NYSE: AXS) today announced that it has appointed Pradip Patiath to the Company’s Board of Directors. Effective June 15, 2026, Mr. Patiath will join the Board, where he will serve on its Risk and Human Capital and Compensation Committees. “Pradip is recognized as one of the foremost thinkers and practitioners in digital strategy in the financial services sector. He is an outstanding addition to our Board, bringing a proven record of success spanning enterprise transformation, artificial intelligence and digital strategy, digital product innovation, and advanced analytics,” said W. Marston Becker, Chair of the Board at AXIS. “We will benefit greatly from Pradip’s depth and breadth of experience, which extends across insurance, banking, private equity, and fintech industries.” Mr. Patiath is presently a Senior Partner at McKinsey Company and a global leader
articles.title: AXIS Appoints Pradip Patiath to Its Board of Directors

articles.summary: Christina Geller to Lead Wholesale Financial Lines at AXIS PEMBROKE, Bermuda, June 3, 2026-AXIS Capital Holdings Limited (AXIS Capital or AXIS or the Company) (NYSE: AXS), today announced the promotion of Christina Geller to Head of Wholesale Financial Lines in North America. Previously, Ms. Geller served as Head of Wholesale Financial Institutions. She has spent a combined 18 years serving in senior underwriting and leadership positions within AXIS from 2005 to 2012 and then returning to the firm from 2013 to present.
